test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Either of these two roads lead to the post office.
solution: The erroneous part is **'lead to'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here,** 'leads to' **should be used instead of **'lead to'.** • We know that** 'either of/ neither of'** is followed by **a plural noun** and** singular verb.** • *Example: **Neither of **my brothers **wants** to be left at home.* • Thus, the erroneous part is **'lead to'.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Either of these two roads **leads to** the post office.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'lead to'** के बजाय** 'leads to'** का इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए। • हम जानते हैं कि 'either of/ neither of' के बाद **plural noun **और **singular verb **आती है। • *Example: **Neither of **my brothers **wants** to be left at home.* • इस प्रकार, गलत हिस्सा **'lead to'** है। d0:Td92, The correct answer is** 'while I was reading'.**
